The [[Forgotten Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] traded by the [[Keeper of Nature]], a [[collector]] who can be found in [[Throne of Secrets]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[hornbow]]s:
**[[Hornbow]] from collector [[Maddison]]
**[[Stoneshard Hornbow]] from collector [[Charmamani]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Destroyer Hornbow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Hornbow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Hornbow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[hornbow]]s:
**[[Stoneshard Hornbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Hornbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Hornbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Hornbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Hornbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Hornbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Hornbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Hornbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Hornbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Hornbow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Hornbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Deldrimor Hornbow (unique)]] and [[Vah's Hornbow]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Guidance]], [[Ironwing Longbow]], [[Mallyx's Longbow]], [[Elswyth's Recurve Bow]], and [[Tundoss' Shortbow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different classes.
